verdict.rationale: Metronome's docs show a comprehensive API covering nearly all billing operations available in the UI—ingest, contracts, subscriptions, seats, pricing, invoicing, revenue recognition, custom fields, idempotency, pagination—suggesting strong API/UI parity for an API-first platform. However, docs explicitly call out at least one UI-only capability (the event explorer for inspecting the event pipeline) with no documented API equivalent, and there's no explicit statement or audit confirming full 1:1 parity across every UI feature (e.g., dashboard customization, sandbox/report building tools). missing for 10: explicit parity statement or audit, API equivalent for event-pipeline inspection/dashboard customization, independent confirmation of full feature parity.
